lines.text: David tells his soul to bless the LORD, who forgives iniquities and renews your youth like the eagle's.
The LORD executes righteousness and justice for the oppressed, and He made His ways known to Aaron.
The LORD is slow to anger, and He removed our transgressions as far as east from west.
The LORD has compassion on those who fear Him like a king on his children, and knows we are dust.
His loving devotion extends from everlasting to everlasting, and His angels, mighty in strength, carry out His word.
